'''Durkteel''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] with a population of approximately 3.2 billion at the dawn of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Saurin/Legends|Saurin]], a subspecies of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] with [[Human/Legends|human]]-like hands. Durkteel was located along the [[Durkteel Loop/Legends|Durkteel Loop]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
[[File:Hrchek-kal-fas.jpg|left|thumb|[[Hrchek Kal Fas/Legends|Hrchek Kal Fas]] followed the droids [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] out of [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Cantina]] but lost them in the streets of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].]]
The Saurin's distant ancestors hailed from [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]], like all Trandoshans. Nevertheless, they split off from their mainline cousins at some point in their evolutionary history.<ref name="ItWoSWT 14">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref> Physiological differences developed in the Saurin subspecies, included differently colored eyes and more digits on each hand.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

The Saurin&mdash;or possibly their Trandoshan ancestors&mdash;eventually made their way to [[Durkteel/Legends|Durkteel]], a world situated a short distance from Trandosha along the [[Durkteel Loop/Legends|Durkteel Loop]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] in the neighboring [[Kastolar sector/Legends|Kastolar sector]]. Sometime between [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000]] and [[8000 BBY]], Durkteel became part of the greater [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] within the heavily explored region known as [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="TEA" />

Durkteel eventually became a wealthy [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]], and investments included the construction of an ever-increasing number of orbiting [[Space station/Legends|space stations]]. Saurin pioneers joined [[Borneck]] and [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] counterparts in the colonization of [[Yitabo/Legends|Yitabo]], a world that lay at the junction of the Durkteel Loop and the [[Pabol Sleheyron/Legends|Pabol Sleheyron]]. Yitabo eventually became a minor agriworld in its own right. Investors swelled Saurin coffers with billions of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in agribusiness, and over time the Saurin became one of the three most powerful indigenous groups in the greater [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region]], along with the Wookiees of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and the [[Bimm (disambiguation)|Bimms]] of [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]].<ref name="TEA" />

Durkteel did not avoid the influence of powerful neighbors beyond the region. By [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], their world and the hyperlanes that connected it with the otherside had fallen into the control of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], making Durkteel part of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. This influence had been broken by [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], when the borders of Hutt Space retracted. Shortly thereafter, however, the [[Jedi Civil War]] erupted, and by [[3959 BBY]], Durkteel had fallen into a region of space controlled by [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]] as part of his [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] a situation that persisted until [[3956 BBY]]. Hutt encroachment in the Kashyyyk Region brought Durkteel once more into the borders of Hutt Space by [[1004 BBY]], and again between [[52 BBY/Legends|52]] and [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

Durkteel joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. With the eruption of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] that year, Durkteel sided with the Republic. The planet became a member of the [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]], a group whose goal was to aid those fleeing conflict zones. Later that year, Durkteel joined nine other worlds to form the Refugee Resettlement Coalition; members agreed to relax immigration laws and take in more refugees. Durkteel's population was 3.2 billion at this time.<ref name="HNN52" />

Nevertheless, Durkteel's proximity to Hutt Space once again placed its Saurin population in Hutt Space. As the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted, the Saurin found their world in [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Space]] as well. Hutt Space had once again retracted, leaving the Saurin outside its grasp, by [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]]. By [[137 ABY]], however, Durkteel and its population fell within the region of space controlled by [[Darth Krayt]] as part of his [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />
